test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS - General Awareness (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: 'Sagol Kangjei' of Manipur has been adapted worldwide by the enthusiasts of this sport as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Polo.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sagol Kangjei** is the name of the game of** polo **played in** Manipur. **
 
• **Sagol** refers to a** pony or horse**,** Kang** to a** ball or round object**, and **jei** to a** hitting stick.**
 
• Polo has long been a game enjoyed by** royalty and the top crust of society,** not only in India but also around the world.
 
• Each participant rides a** pony** that is **4 to 5 feet tall.** The field measures** 210 yards in length** and** 100 yards in width** and is** rectangular in design**. The player must hit the ball with his stick because there is **no goal post**. A **narrow angled wooden head **is placed at the **bottom end of the cane stick**.
 
• Manipur has the oldest polo ground in the world at Imphal’s Mapal Kangjeibung. It is said that Manipur's deity-king Kangba invented the game in the 14th century BC, and in 33 AD, King Nongda Pakhangba hosted the first polo match. It hosts the Manipur International Polo Festival every year which is attended by a lot of polo fans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Legends say that the inhabitants of Manipur are originally** Gandharvas **– the** celestial singers and dancers.**
 
• **Keibul Lamjao National Park** is situated on the** floating Loktak Lake of Manipur.** It has a vast wetland populated with** dense dead and decaying floating vegetation **called** Phumdi**. It is home to the **endangered Sangai** or the** brow-antlered deer** and **rare flora** which are also the **state animal of Manipur. **
 
• The local mothers who run the small shops at** Manipur’s all-women market** are referred to as **Imas in Manipur.** The market is divided into** two sections** on either side of the road. The market is remotely located on the **Indo-Myanmar border**. **No men** are allowed to sell their wares at this market.
 
• Manipur is one of the** northeastern sister states** where an **Inner Line Permit is required.**
 
• **Nongthombam Biren Singh** is an Indian politician, former footballer, and journalist, who is currently serving as the** Chief Minister of Manipur **for the second term since 2017.
